description: Read Canada's official statistics from Statistics Canada: the Consumer Price Index, jobs and unemployment, GDP, population, housing, trade and thousands more tables. Search the tables, see what a table holds, pick a series by name, get its latest figures or those between two dates, and see what was released on a day. No account or API key required.
